title: Neighbourhood spreading of a finite etale stalk model with comparison
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian quasi-separated scheme and $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism locally of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]. Let $U\subset S$ be open, $C_U=c^{-1}(U)$ with inclusion $i_U:C_U\to C$, and $P\to C_U$ finite etale [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $s\in S$, $a_s:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$ its canonical stalk morphism, $C_s^{\mathrm{loc}}=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, and $Q\to C_s^{\mathrm{loc}}$ finite etale [def-pc-fibre-product]. Suppose given an isomorphism $\operatorname{pr}_1^*P\simeq\operatorname{pr}_2^*Q$ on $C_U\times_C C_s^{\mathrm{loc}}$. Then there are an open neighbourhood $W\ni s$ and a finite etale cover $R\to C_W=c^{-1}(W)$ with an isomorphism $P|_{C_U\cap C_W}\simeq R|_{C_U\cap C_W}$ over the intersection, using its canonical inclusions into $C_U$ and $C_W$. No integrality, smoothness, section, torsor, or invertibility hypothesis is assumed; $s$ may lie in $U$.

proof.text: Express Spec O(S,s) as the inverse limit of affine open neighbourhoods W of s, using the stalk limit theorem. Base change by c; C_W is qcqs and has affine transitions. Its limit is the local family.

Descend Q, a finitely presented scheme over the local family, to C_W by finite-presentation limit descent, as in the proof of Tag 0BQ5. After shrinking W its morphism is finite and etale by the property descent results underlying Tag 0EY3.

Noetherianity makes U retrocompact, so C_(U intersect W) is qcqs and forms a system with the local overlap as limit. Descend the comparison and its inverse by finite-presentation morphism descent in Tag 0BQ5. Descend their two identity equations after a common further shrinking; this gives an isomorphism on the intersection. The two projections identify with the canonical open inclusions. Return that W and its finite etale cover; no gluing is needed.
